description: Find FCC ULS authorizations whose occupied band overlaps a frequency or band. Site assignments (land mobile, microwave, paging, cellular sites) return one row per site and frequency with the site's state and coordinates; market-area licenses and leases (PCS, AWS, 700 MHz, 3.45 and 3.7 GHz, and other auctioned blocks) return one row per spectrum block with its market code and name; 3.5 GHz Priority Access Licenses file no frequency, so list them with fcc_spectrum_search_licenses and radio_service PL. Filter by state, radio service, licensee, FRN, market code, and live status (active by default). For transmitter sites near a coordinate, use fcc_spectrum_find_transmitters.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of the same search; omit for the first page.

frequency_high.description: Band upper edge in unit; omit to search a single frequency.

frequency_low.description: Frequency in unit; with frequency_high, the band's lower edge. Matches any authorization whose occupied band overlaps.

frn.description: Licensee's FCC Registration Number, up to 10 digits; spaces and hyphens are removed and it is left-padded with zeros. Individual licensees match and are returned redacted.

kind.description: site: transmitter-site assignments only; market: market-area spectrum blocks only; both (default).

licensee.description: Licensee name words, with at least one letter or digit; every word must match the start of a word in the name, in any order. A word joined by - or & ("T-Mobile", "AT&T") matches its pieces side by side.

market_code.description: Market code of the license, matched exactly, e.g. "PEA016", "CMA020", or "NW" (nationwide); market rows carry it as marketCode. Applies to site and market rows alike, since cellular (CMA) licenses file sites rather than blocks. Case, spaces, and hyphens are ignored, and the digits are left-padded with zeros ("pea16" reads as PEA016).

radio_service.description: Two-character radio service code, e.g. "WU" (700 MHz upper band); see fcc_spectrum_list_reference topic "radio_services".

state.description: Two-letter USPS code or full state name. Sites match on their filed state, or the state derived from their coordinates. Market blocks match when their FCC market area reaches the state (a multi-state market matches each of its states), their market name carries the state code, or their license files a site there; nationwide and Gulf of Mexico markets match no state.

status.description: A active (default), L pending legal, X term pending, or "any" for all three. Other statuses keep no frequency records.

unit.description: Unit of the frequencies: kHz, MHz (default), or GHz.

name: fcc_spectrum_search_frequencies

appliedFilters.description: Filters as the server applied them, normalized values and defaults included.

frequency_high_mhz.description: Band upper edge, converted to MHz (equal to the lower edge for one frequency).

frequency_low_mhz.description: Band lower edge, converted to MHz.

assignments.description: Matching site assignments and market blocks, frequency ascending.

items.description: One site assignment or market spectrum block.

bandwidthMhz.description: Widest necessary bandwidth parsed from the emission designators, MHz (site rows); a designator 20% of the assigned frequency or wider is a filing error and is left out.

callsign.description: Callsign, or lease ID on a lease.

emissions.description: Distinct emission designators filed for this frequency (site rows).

frequencyMhz.description: Assigned frequency (site) or block lower edge (market), MHz.

isLease.description: True for a spectrum leasing arrangement.

kind.description: site: a frequency at a transmitter site; market: a spectrum block across a market area.

latitude.description: Site latitude, decimal degrees (site rows with valid coordinates); the center of an operating area when radiusKm is filed.

licenseStatus.description: License status code (A, L, or X).

licenseeName.description: Licensee (lessee on a lease) as filed; null when redacted or not on file.

licenseeRedacted.description: True when the licensee is an individual whose name is withheld.

locationNumber.description: Location number within the license (site rows); pass it as location_number to fcc_spectrum_get_license to read the location's antennas and frequencies.

locationTypeCode.description: ULS location type code, e.g. F (fixed), M (mobile), T (temporary fixed) (site rows at a single site; absent when not filed).

locationTypeLabel.description: Label of the location type code, e.g. "Mobile" (site rows at a single site).

longitude.description: Site longitude, decimal degrees (site rows with valid coordinates); the center of an operating area when radiusKm is filed.

marketCode.description: Market code (market rows); pass it as market_code to search that market.

marketName.description: Market name as filed, cut at 30 characters by ULS (market rows).

maxErpW.description: Highest effective radiated power filed, watts (site rows).

partitionAreaIds.description: ULS partition areas this block is filed under (market rows); a partitioned license files one block per area, returned here as one row.

radioServiceLabel.description: Label of the radio service code.

radiusKm.description: Radius of operation around latitude/longitude, km, as filed (site rows at a single site); mobile (M) and temporary-fixed (T) areas file one, and some fixed and other sites do.

sitesSharingNumber.description: Sites the license files under this location number, when more than one (site rows); ULS does not say which of them uses the frequency, so the row has no coordinates, location type, radius, county, or state. fcc_spectrum_get_license lists the sites.

state.description: Site state, as filed or derived from the coordinates (site rows).

stateFromCoordinates.description: True when state was derived from the coordinates rather than filed (site rows).

stationClasses.description: Distinct station classes filed for this frequency at the site (site rows).

upperMhz.description: Upper edge of a ranged site assignment or of a market block, MHz.

usi.description: Unique system identifier of the license; pass it to fcc_spectrum_get_license.

dataAsOf.description: Creation time of the newest applied ULS file (ISO 8601).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `index_not_ready`: No completed index generation is published yet. `invalid_frequency_range`: frequency_high is below frequency_low, or the band exceeds 300 GHz. `unknown_radio_service`: The radio service code is neither in the FCC code table nor held by the index. `service_not_indexed`: The radio service code is valid but no indexed service group carries it. `invalid_cursor`: The cursor does not decode or belongs to an earlier index generation. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor with the same inputs for the next page; absent on the last page. A page over a dense band can hold fewer rows than limit and still carry one.

notice.description: Why nothing matched, what the state and redaction rules skipped, or how to page further.

totalCount.description: Rows matching the filters, across every page; at least this many when totalIsLowerBound is true.

totalIsLowerBound.description: True when a dense band was counted only in part, so totalCount is a lower bound; absent when the count is exact.

truncated.description: True when more rows follow this page.

title: Search FCC ULS authorizations by frequency
